title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal AI…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Drupal AI (Artificial Intelligence) component due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability affects versions from 0.0.0 to 1.4.11 and from 1.5.0 to 1.5.2 of the Drupal AI module. The flaw allows injection of malicious scripts into web pages, potentially impacting users who view the affected content.
